method: requirements-check-1 (Sonnet 5 judge + Sonnet 5 check; disagreements unknown; quotes verified)

apiKey.keyFor: A saved browser Cookie (your own publisher login) for each site; without one it falls back to Zotero's normal downloader

evidence.quote: For sites you configure, the plugin sends your saved Cookie; everything else stays with Zotero's native downloader.
It does not find papers, bypass access rights, refresh logins, or replace Zotero's resolvers.

checkNote: README: "For sites you configure, the plugin sends your saved Cookie; everything else stays with Zotero's native downloader." Its only purpose is sending your own login Cookie. It has no AI features.
